title: Gemini 1.5: Multimodal Understanding Across Long Context
hook: Gemini 1.5 Pro processes up to a million tokens in context - enough for entire codebases, hours of video, or book-length documents - in a single multimodal model.
key_points: Context window extended to up to 1 million tokens, far beyond any contemporary model at release, enabling long-document and long-video understanding.
Natively multimodal: handles text, images, audio, and video in one model without separate encoders stitched together.
Uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture to achieve strong performance while managing compute cost at scale.
Near-perfect recall on long-context retrieval tasks (needle-in-a-haystack tests) even at maximum context length.
content_html: Google's Gemini team published the Gemini 1.5 technical report in March 2024, describing a family of multimodal models built around an unusually large context window. Gemini 1.5 Pro supports up to one million tokens of context — later extended further in deployment — enabling it to reason over entire codebases, multi-hour videos, or very long documents in a single call.
extra_html:
How it works

Gemini 1.5 is a natively multimodal model: text, image, audio, and video tokens are all processed within the same transformer, trained together from the start rather than combined post-hoc. The model uses a sparse Mixture-of-Experts design to maintain high capacity while keeping per-token compute tractable. The long context window is enabled by efficient attention mechanisms that don't degrade in quality at extreme lengths.

Why it matters

A million-token context window is qualitatively different from previous 32K or 128K windows: it shifts what counts as "too long to fit." Tasks like debugging a full codebase, summarizing a day's worth of meeting transcripts, or searching through hours of video become feasible within a single prompt. Read the technical report on arXiv.

related.title: GPT-4o: One Model for Text, Audio, and Vision
related.hook: GPT-4o is a single model that natively processes text, audio, and images end-to-end - no separate speech pipeline - cutting voice response latency to near human conversational speed.

related.title: Mixtral of Experts
related.hook: Mixtral packs 8 experts per layer but routes each token through only 2, so you get the capacity of a ~47B model at the compute cost of a ~13B one - open weights included.

related.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
related.hook: Interleave images and text in a prompt, use cross-attention to inject visual features into a frozen LLM, and get few-shot image understanding without retraining the language model.
